bio: A family-oriented establishment near the Montesinho Natural Park, where the virtues of the local Bragança cuisine are showcased. The place, easy to spot as it is right by the road, features a large car park, a public bar and two rustic-style dining rooms, both displaying hunting-themed decorations. The menu showcases regional Trás-os-Montes recipes and game dishes, always in hearty servings and based on fresh produce. Don’t miss the stewed wild boar with chestnuts, hare rice, Bragança-style lamb... or the wonderful grilled wild boar sirloin....
